task.title: Filter corpus samples by provenance repository path
task.objective: Select validated records by exact repository-path equality without resolving or inspecting the path
acceptance_criteria: The predicate composes before the sample limit
Malformed records still reject the complete sample
The exact head merges only after substantive review and successful quality gates

attempts.summary: Added focused exact-match, composition, limit, empty-result, and malformed-record tests
attempts.diagnostic: Clap rejected the unimplemented repository-path option

attempts.summary: Threaded repository-path input into sampling and compared provenance text directly
Preserved the exact head while automatic review capacity was unavailable, then resumed review after cooldown
attempts.diagnostic: The initial CodeRabbit result was rate limited and therefore was not accepted as substantive review evidence
attempts.patch: No code change; auto-merge remained disabled until exact-head review completed

outcome.summary: Sampling supports authority-neutral exact repository-path filtering and merged after exact-head review

lessons: Treat repository paths as inert corpus metadata unless separate authority is explicitly granted
Validate the full corpus before filtering and limiting
A rate-limited green status is not substantive review evidence
